span.p:
three failures of a feedforward net · §2
variable length · no order awareness · no parameter sharing

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
RNN · hₜ = tanh(W_hh hₜ₋₁ + W_xh xₜ + b) · §3–4
one shared W + a hidden state carried forward · hₜ = a compressed summary of x₁…xₜ

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
∂L/∂h_k = ∂L/∂h_T · Π W_hhᵀ · diag(1 − hₜ²) · §5–6
a product of T factors, each < 1 · ρ(W_hh) < 1 → vanish · > 1 → explode
0.9¹⁰⁰ ≈ 0.0000265 → dead · effective memory ≈ 44 steps

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
gradient clipping
fixes explode only — rescales, keeps direction

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
truncated BPTT
a compute fix, not a learning fix — deletes long range

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
LSTM · Cₜ = fₜ ⊙ Cₜ₋₁ + iₜ ⊙ C̃ₜ · §9–11
ADDITION, so ∂Cₜ/∂Cₜ₋₁ = fₜ — a learned number · 0.99¹⁰⁰ ≈ 0.366 → survives
forget = ERASE · input = WRITE · output = REVEAL · C is protected, h is the exposed view

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
GRU · §15
merge f, i → z · drop the cell state · ¾ the params · ⚠ z-convention trap

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
BiRNN · §17–19
reads only one way → h = [h→ ; h←] · dim = 2 × hidden · illegal if you generate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Seq2Seq · §20
one output per input → encoder → context → decoder · lengths independent · ⚠ context = bottleneck

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
And how to build all of it · §21–25
Tensors → Autograd (backward() IS BPTT) → nn.Module → DataLoader → the 5-step loop
